Aung San Suu Kyi speaks with son after five years of imprisonment

Aung San Suu Kyi, the imprisoned former leader of Myanmar, has spoken with her son for the first time in five years. Her son reported that she sounded "fairly healthy" following the call. This event marks a significant breakthrough in communication with the detained political figure.
